New Energy and Industrial Technology Development Organization (NEDO) (2008). Global Warming Countermeasures: Japanese Technologies for Energy Savings/GHG Emissions Reduction, 2008 Revised Edition. NEDO Kyoto Mechanisms Promotion Department, Kawasaki.

HELD COPY IS TRUNCATED: the file is exactly 1,048,576 bytes of a linearized PDF whose header declares 9,939,373 bytes and 357 pages; the page tree is lost. Pages were recovered by scanning the raw file for page objects (pypdf, strict=False): readable = cover/copyright and contents (front pages 3-8), Preface and body printed pp.1-48 except pp.11 and 23 (broken objects); i.e. only Section 2.1 Common Elemental Equipment (boilers, steam piping, compressors, industrial furnaces, fluidic devices, transformers, power supply, motors, lighting, air-conditioning). LOST: everything from printed p.49 on (about 300 pages), including all sector chapters (iron and steel, cement, chemicals, petroleum refining, pulp and paper), cogeneration, renewables and the parts UKERC cites. The file must be re-downloaded (ctc-n.org or ietd.iipnetwork.org). Locator: printed page numbers. Loaded: condensing (latent heat recovery) boiler efficiency and the conventional boiler range (main file), 17 cross-cutting measures with savings, yen costs and payback (_measures), transformer losses and UPS efficiency (other-values). Most examples are reprinted from ECCJ 'Energy saving Diagnosis Examples' and NEDO FY2000 survey (2001). Traps: yen price year not stated (2008 assumed); some printed units look wrong ('1,507 MJ/y' for drain recovery; '23,576 Gcal/y' for a 2.7 kWh/t pump saving) and are kept as printed in notes only.
